captions.linkedin:
AQR runs billions on one signal across 9 asset classes. Koijen, Moskowitz, Pedersen and Vrugt published the whole framework in JFE 2018. The signal is carry.

Not FX carry. Not bond carry. Carry as a universal concept that works in every market with a forward curve or a yield.

Here's the complete logic. No black box:

🔹 NINE ASSET CLASSES. Equities, bonds, the yield curve itself, FX, commodities, credit, and options (both calls and puts).
🔹 UNIFIED DEFINITION. Carry = forward or futures premium, or yield plus roll, across any asset.
🔹 MONTHLY REBALANCE. Rank instruments by carry, long high-carry, short low-carry.
🔹 RANK-WEIGHTED. Dollar-neutral long-short weights proportional to carry rank.
🔹 DIVERSIFIED SCALING. Inverse-volatility weight per class so no single market dominates risk.
🔹 RECESSION RISK. Joint crash exposure in 1975, 1982 and 2008 creates real negative skew. Sharpe alone hides it.

Koijen, Moskowitz, Pedersen, Vrugt 2018. Sample 1972 to 2012. Crowding post-publication. Tail risk understated. You verify it.
